attempts.summary: A helper signature mismatch stopped the wrapper before adversarial controls. Baseline reproductions completed, but this attempt is not acceptance evidence. No original source or legacy destination was written.

The read-text/read-bytes overlay priority was wrong, so duplicate-control output hashes reflected original source bytes instead of intended altered bytes. Captures and intermediate audit are retained under failed-attempts/ and excluded from authoritative findings.

Fixed overlay priority for both Path.read_text and Path.read_bytes; reran each exact pinned legacy entry point twice and inventory adversarial controls. See legacy-reproduction-audit.json. Its duplicate outputs and hashes are authoritative for this worker's fixtures; they differ from the issue reporter's separately generated duplicate fixture hashes.

The first additive successor run correctly produced 210 pairs and 35 changed areas but reported differing contacts as a repeated pair count (210) rather than distinct source contacts. Output is retained under failed-attempts/producer-first-run/ and excluded. The field was corrected to count distinct contacts.

Two fresh successor executions after the summary correction produced identical 101810-byte outputs (SHA-256 af573ff25ba961ea574ed08214ab9befbe95626d6b78977cc329c914222fc5de); each lists 210 unique pairs, 35 changed-area pairs, and 10 distinct contacts with non-equal full geometries.

An initial control helper incorrectly expected the inventory indexer alone to detect a missing row; the indexer checks identity uniqueness, while complete row count is a separate producer invariant. The assertion aborted before writing a control receipt. The corrected receipt records duplicate identity rejection and the explicit complete-count guard; no source or existing evidence output was changed.

Added fail-closed geometry validity and output-root safety checks; reran two fresh successor vintages with identical output hashes. Probed empty/invalid geometry, path traversal, collision and symlinked output root; all rejected. Full control receipt is vintages/producer-controls-final-20261007/controls.json.
